A list of all the hybrid units in the game. Hybrid units often only become hybrid from upgrading, but a select few units are capable of being hybrid ON PLACEMENT such as Toshin (Dragon Lotus) and Ulquiro (Resurrección). Hybrid units are units capable of hitting both airs AND grounds at certain upgrades OR they can be hybrid upon placement.

Bakugo (Howitzer)
Lua error in Module:UnitData at line 392: attempt to index field '?' (a nil value).Lua error in Module:UnitData at line 392: attempt to index field '?' (a nil value).
Ultimate DPS, Good AoE Circle and great range! Through the power of Bakugo and his quirk, he is indeed capable of dealing some of the most EXPLOSIVE amounts of damage in the game for a hybrid unit, his abilities to hit airs, while also having good damage and DPS make him a viable unit in infinite mode, story mode, etc. He is abnormally strong for a physical hybrid because of the lack of viable physical hybrid units, especially having 4 placements, which increases his total group DPS. Bakugo may be often slept on because of other units out-performing him, however, Bakugo is still an extremely solid unit and can be a great asset for your team. When equipped with the Lostvain or the Nail, he can do even more damage and can be one of the best secondary damaging units in the game!

Vegita (Super II)
Lua error in Module:UnitData at line 392: attempt to index field '?' (a nil value).Lua error in Module:UnitData at line 392: attempt to index field '?' (a nil value).
Ultimate DPS, Low SPA, Great Range. Upon reaching Upgrade 8, Vegita becomes apart of the affinity of Hybrid Units. Vegita's damage capabilities are truly insane which are allowed by his high damage, fairly low SPA, range and his placement cap of 3! Upon release, this unit was being compared to Geno (Incinerate) because of there extremely similar stat bases, but Vegita comes out on top, being an INSANE hybrid unit and EXTREMELY great physical unit. Vegita barely beats Metal Knight because of their DPS's being so close, however, with a placement cap of 3, allowing him to do more DPS and DPM. Vegita is often slept on for his damage, but he can truly be one heck of a DPS unit in both infinite mode, story, and legend stages! Vegita's pride and determination hold him to be one of the strongest units in the game. (Costs 74.7K¥ to reach his maximum upgrade.)

Ultimate DPS, Good AoE Circle, Good Range. Through the power of her Elemental Demonic Power, Akena is not very far from being on the rankings for one of the best hybrid units in the game, even though her release was on April Fools, her performance capabilities surely aren't a joke! Unfortunately, being a magic unit, there are options better than her, however, she is still a good candidate for dishing out damage in infinite mode! Unique to Akena gains hybrid on UPGRADE 3, making her one of the BEST Hybrid/Hill Units for Story Mode! A cherry on top for Akena is that she is fairly easy to obtain, which makes her a good unit for returning players! Don't sleep on Akena, because she is capable of doing insane amounts of damage and be viable in multiple modes!

Per-Unit (single) DPS is usually what most people in the community talk about as calculations are easier without taking into account number of placement. Please keep in mind that while certain characters' singular DPS may be higher than others, placement limits affect Total DPS significantly. The approximate range for DPS (PER SINGLE UNIT) descriptions are:

  • Bad DPS 1,000-2000
  • Moderate DPS 2,001-3,000
  • Good DPS 3,001-4000
  • High DPS 4,001-5,000
  • Great DPS 5,001-6,000
  • Amazing DPS 6,001-7,000
  • Massive DPS 7,001-8,000
  • Insane DPS 8,001-9,000
  • Colossal DPS 9,001-10,000
  • Ultimate DPS 10,001-25,000
  • Godly DPS 25,001-30,000+

DPS accounts for the DMG (Damage) of a unit divided by its SPA (Attack Speed). The Total damage of a unit can be higher or lower as some units can only be placed 3, 4, 5, etc. amount times.
